Order Management System

One system that follows every customer order from the first inquiry to final pickup, so nothing is lost, forgotten or left unpaid.

  • Separate logins for each team. Admin, design and production each see only their own work.
  • Design approval before printing. No job starts until the design is approved, which prevents costly reprints.
  • Payments tracked automatically. Down payments, balances and release of finished orders in one place.
  • Live production board. Quality checks and a full history of every step.
  • Reports at a glance. Sales, completed orders and unpaid balances, always up to date.
  • Backup you own. Every order is saved here first, then copied automatically to a Google Sheet, so the owner can restore all data if the main system ever crashes.

Case study

Dental Website + Booking System

A complete website and appointment workflow designed to make it easier for patients to request appointments and easier for the clinic to manage them.

Patient→Website→Booking Request→Availability Check→Dashboard→Google Sheets Backup
Problem

Appointment requests arrived through messages and a notebook. The clinic couldn't easily see availability, and requests slipped through the cracks.

Solution

A dental website with an appointment request form that checks availability, saves each booking in the dashboard with a booking ID, backs it up to Google Sheets, and emails the clinic and the patient.

Result

A live dashboard with pending, booked, rebooked and cancelled bookings, today's appointments, a 14-day chart, and conflict flags for dentist days off.

"We went from juggling four different platforms to having 100% of our booking requests handled in one single dashboard."Dental clinic client
Technical Details

Website form → Google Apps Script → Dashboard (booking ID, availability, status; main record) → Google Sheets backup → email notifications.

FAQ

Common questions

Do you only build websites?

No. Websites are one part. I also build the systems behind them: lead capture, dashboards with automatic Google Sheets backup, Apps Script automation, appointment workflows and AI assistants.

Where is my data stored, and what happens if the system crashes?

Every order and booking is saved directly in your main dashboard, which is the one source of truth. A Google Sheet that you own receives an automatic backup copy of each record. If the main system ever crashes, the owner can restore all data from that sheet.

Does AI do the work for you?

No. I use AI tools like Claude to work faster, then implement, test and refine every system myself so it fits your process.

Can your AI assistant give medical advice?

No. For healthcare it only handles general information, hours, services, location, appointment inquiries and contact collection.

Do you work with international clients?

Yes. I work remotely and communicate by email or message. My hours are flexible, so I can overlap with US business hours. Tell me your time zone and we'll plan around it.

What happens after my site or system goes live?

I monitor it for 7 days after launch. If something I built has a problem during that time, I fix it at no cost to you.

How much does a project cost?

Websites start from $400. Larger projects with booking, CRM or AI depend on scope. Share what you need through the form and I'll reply with a practical recommendation and quote.

What do I need to get started?

Just a short description of what you want to improve. Fill in the quick form and I'll reply with a practical recommendation.
